course.title: TV Engineering
course.department: Department of Electronics and Communication Engineering

content.value: A graded index fiber has a parabolic refractive index profile (α=2) and a core  (10) diameter of 50 μm. Estimate the insertion loss due to a 3 μm lateal misalignment at a fiber joint when there is index matching and assuming:
(i) there is uniform illumination of all guided modes only.
(ii) there is uniform illumination of all guided and leaky modes.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 4th Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2015
